text:
rachel: Quick thought 1: instead of a single sensitivity slider, what about showing "confidence bands" on the rollout panel (green/yellow/red) that map to different degrade behaviors? gives operators visual thresholds.

priya: I like bands. need the preview to be rooted in telemetry though 1: show expected fallback counts per band using last 1h/24h windows.

mike: Can we offer a "simulate" button that replays recent traffic and shows how many requests would hit each band? avoids guesswork.

dave: Audit question: simulations should not pollute compliance traces. propose sims emit only aggregated counts + sample id. real runs still emit breadcrumbs but we can compact them.
audit-bot: audit-bot: note: all "simulation" events will be tagged sim=true and excluded from PII/compliance export by default.

rachel: Also want an "escape hatch" (global rollback) on the same panel. must be gated by RBAC + a confirmation modal.

priya: Microcopy draft: "Confidence bands control how aggressively the system falls back to safer model variants when anomalies occur. Use Simulate to preview impact on recent traffic." short and scannable.

mike: Example compact breadcrumb we discussed (200B target):
```json
{"reason":"err_rate","band":"yellow","fallback":"lite_quant","score":0.57,"audit_id":"zz9x"}
```

dave: Retention proposal: full decision traces 14d, compact breadcrumbs 180d, simulation aggregates 7d. make per-org overrideable.

rachel: Edgecase: per-route whitelists. billing/identity routes should default to stricter bands (ie less aggressive). need per-route presets.

priya: UX: show inline per-route toggle + small badge explaining preset ("billing: conservative").

mike: Action items: 1) @mike implement simulate endpoint + aggregated preview report. 2) @priya mock bands + escape-hatch UI in Figma. 3) @dave cost/retention calc for proposed windows. 4) @rachel draft product spec and RBAC requirements.

ops-bot: deploybot: canary-sim for confidence-bands scheduled on staging at 04:00 UTC :rocket:

dave: I'll run retention numbers later today and post here.

rachel: Great, if we can get a short staging run we can screenshot the preview bar for the spec. thanks all :thumbsup:
